patterns.note: Full-bleed video hero section with a dark overlay, ensuring text readability over dynamic background content.
Overall dark mode interface with high-contrast white text and subtle light grey elements for cards and input fields.
Horizontal scrolling section for customer testimonials, allowing many cards to be displayed without excessive vertical space.
Subtle purple-to-blue gradient used as a visual separator and background element between dark sections, adding depth and brand accent.
Exceptionally large and bold sans-serif numbers used for social proof metrics, creating a strong visual impact.
The hero video background scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect that adds depth to the initial view.
Content sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining access to key links throughout the scroll.

technique_notes: A full-width video element is positioned behind the main hero content, playing on loop, with a semi-transparent dark overlay applied to ensure text contrast and readability. The video background is set to scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect.
The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the browser window, ensuring it remains visible and accessible as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections of content are configured to animate into view, typically with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation, as they become visible within the user's viewport during scrolling.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body size) with clean, readable body text; social proof numbers are exceptionally large and bold (~5-6x body size).
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and feature cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but a tighter grid for feature cards and footer links.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated dark mode aesthetic combined with an immersive, full-bleed video hero that subtly parallaxes. The strategic use of vibrant, yet controlled, purple-to-blue gradients as visual transitions between dark sections adds a distinctive, almost 'luxe' feel to a crypto service, elevating it beyond typical fintech designs.
